optimizedDescription.value: Defines immutable language-agnostic graph nodes, compact analysis facts, deterministic lookups, and typed relations.

optimizedContext.value:
# Symbol Model

## Rules

- `FileNode`: source file; `path: string` canonical globally unique `{workspaceName}:{relativeToCodeRoot}`, forward-slash-normalized; `configRelativePath: string` config-directory-relative, normalized, MAY contain `..`, never identity; `language: string`; `contentHash: string`; `workspace: string`; `embedding: Float32Array | undefined`. Equality iff `path` matches.
- `SpecNode`: spec directory; `specId: string` identity in `workspace:package/topic`; workspace-relative `path`; metadata `title` default `specId`; metadata `description` default empty; `contentHash` and `content` from artifacts excluding `.specd-metadata.yaml`, ordered `spec.md` then others alphabetically; ordered metadata `dependsOn`, default `[]`; `workspace`. Equality iff `specId` matches.
- `SymbolNode`: named construct; deterministic globally unique `id` from `filePath + kind + name + line + column`; `name`; `kind: SymbolKind`; workspace-prefixed `filePath`; 1-based `line`; 0-based `column`; optional raw `comment`. Specs, Files, Symbols, Documents MUST use workspace-qualified canonical primary keys.
- Runtime analysis MUST be immutable, compact, separate from persisted graph-store entities: `FileAnalysisDraft` before run-local identity; `FileAnalysis` with run-local ID, workspace-prefixed path, language, content hash, compact facts, optional per-file state; optional `ParserState` only to avoid repeated same-run deterministic work; optional `AdapterSessionState` only for deterministic same-run cross-file caches. Draft/analysis include symbols, imports, binding facts, call facts, supported namespace/qualified-name context, optional normalized file/document metadata. MUST NOT alter persisted symbol IDs, relation IDs, or schemas.
- Run-scoped shared lookups MUST bound resolution by relevant matches: files by workspace-prefixed path/run-local ID; symbols by file/simple/qualified name; file↔symbols; same-run specs/documents; spec↔covered symbols when needed; relation deduplication before persistence. `IndexSession` and `SymbolIndex` MAY collaborate; all built-in adapters/indexer phases MUST share common contract.
- Retained `ParserState`, `AdapterSessionState`, bindings, calls, imports, indexes MUST use compact immutable plain data; MUST NOT retain AST nodes, parser trees, parser cursors, or equivalent heavyweight objects after per-file analysis.
- `DocumentNode`: searchable full-text non-code file identified by path. Document identity matches `FileNode` format `workspace:path`, including reserved `root:`.
- `SymbolKind` closed string enum: `function`, `class`, `method`, `variable`, `type`, `interface`, `enum`. Adapters MUST map constructs to these or skip them.
- Relations: typed edges with `source`, `target`, `type`:

| Type | Source→Target | Meaning | Phase |
|---|---|---|---|
| `IMPORTS` | File→File | imports | v1.5 |
| `DEFINES` | File→Symbol | declaration containment | v2 |
| `CALLS` | Symbol→Symbol | invocation | v2 |
| `CONSTRUCTS` | Symbol→Symbol | construction/instantiation | v2 |
| `USES_TYPE` | Symbol→Symbol | static signature/binding type reference | v2 |
| `EXPORTS` | File→Symbol | public API export | v2 |
| `DEPENDS_ON` | Spec→Spec | spec dependency | v1.5 |
| `COVERS_FILE` | Spec→File | file-level implementation link | v2+ |
| `COVERS_SYMBOL` | Spec→Symbol | symbol-level implementation link | v2+ |
| `EXTENDS` | Symbol→Symbol | inheritance | v2 |
| `IMPLEMENTS` | Symbol→Symbol | contract/type fulfillment | v2 |
| `OVERRIDES` | Symbol→Symbol | method replacement/concrete fulfillment | v2 |

- `Relation`: `source: string`, `target: string`, `type: RelationType`, optional `metadata: Record<string, unknown>`. Equality iff source, target, type match. Metadata MAY contain `stale: boolean`; `stale` applies only to `COVERS_SYMBOL` with currently undetectable target, never generic workspace-boundary/archive-materialization failure.
- Hierarchy normalization: `EXTENDS` type→inherited type; `IMPLEMENTS` type→contract-bearing symbol; `OVERRIDES` method→replaced/concretized/fulfilled inherited or contract method. `OVERRIDES` is persisted, not derived. Adapters MAY normalize inheritance-adjacent constructs only when useful semantics remain for understanding, impact, hotspots, affected specs.
- `ImportDeclaration`: `localName: string`; `originalName: string`; raw `specifier: string`; `isRelative: boolean`; optional `kind: 'named' | 'namespace' | 'default' | 'side-effect' | 'dynamic' | 'require' | 'blank' | undefined`, where `undefined` equals `named`. Pure syntax; indexer resolves files/symbol IDs via adapter registry and monorepo map. Side-effect, string-literal dynamic, CommonJS `require()`, Go blank imports MUST support file-only declarations with empty local/original names and no fake symbols.
- Scoped binding model MUST provide immutable language-agnostic, source-aware facts for deterministic resolution: file/class/type/method/function/block scope ownership; bindings from local, parameter, property/field, class-managed, inherited, file/global, imported type, framework-managed, constructor call, alias-from-known-binding sources; free/member/static/constructor call facts with enclosing caller when known; deterministic reason plus optional confidence/diagnostics for accepted/dropped candidates. Facts MUST have `readonly` properties and workspace-prefixed paths/IDs. Parent-scope traversal MUST detect cycles, abort, return no result.
- First scoped-binding iteration MUST NOT model arbitrary runtime state, reflection, runtime container identifiers, interprocedural propagation, or whole-program data flow.
- Deterministic output: `IMPORTS` resolved files; `CALLS` callable invocations; `CONSTRUCTS` constructor-like instantiations; `USES_TYPE` resolved type/class/interface/enum references; `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES` hierarchy/fulfillment. Constructor injection plus typed parameters, returns, properties/fields, imported annotations SHALL emit `USES_TYPE` when deterministically resolved. Constructor-like calls SHALL emit `CONSTRUCTS` when deterministically resolved. Drop all self symbol→same-symbol dependency relations before persistence. Unresolved facts MUST NOT create speculative edges; MAY remain non-persisted diagnostics/debug metadata.
- All model types and aggregates MUST be immutable value objects with `readonly` properties. Graph mutation only through atomic `GraphStore` upserts replacing whole file-scoped slices; no in-place mutation API.
- `SpecdCodeGraphError` MUST extend `SpecdError` from `@specd/core`; all package errors MUST extend it and inherit Specd Error Contract (`specd: true`, machine-readable `code`). Errors: `InvalidSymbolKindError`, `InvalidRelationTypeError`, `DuplicateSymbolIdError`, `StoreNotOpenError`.

## Constraints

- Model identity only structural equality, except deterministic `SymbolNode.id`.
- `SymbolKind` closed; new kind requires spec change.
- `RelationType` closed; new type requires spec change.
- Runtime dependency: `@specd/core`.
- `FileNode.embedding` deferred v2+; adapters MUST NOT populate before embedding pipeline.
- `COVERS_FILE`/`COVERS_SYMBOL` types exist but no v1.5/v2 process populates them; deferred v2+.
- Indexer populates `DEPENDS_ON` in v1.5 from `.specd-metadata.yaml` or `spec.md`.
- `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES` are first-class persisted v2 base vocabulary for supported languages.
